name: memory-kit
description: Claude Code tools that travel with memory-kit: the read-only obligations pane, the watch, and kit-update.

plugins.name: obligations-pane
plugins.description: Read-only side pane over the memory-kit obligations tier.

plugins.name: watch
plugins.description: Delivers a home's declared inboxes into the session (idle-safe); optional checkpoint-and-retire on idle.

plugins.name: kit-update
plugins.description: Checks for memory-kit releases on the home's channel every N minutes and prompts the session once per release; never runs git.
